subject: Legacy supplier pilot — invoice-only onboarding request
messages:
From: Jessica Park <jessica@oldtownsys.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding OldTown Systems — pilot invoicing & PO?

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really excited about the potential for OldTown to use Redwood for our storefront search experiments. We want to run a 6-week pilot (approx. $9,500 total) starting mid-Oct. Quick note on procurement: our parent finance platform is a legacy system and does not generate purchase orders for pilots under $25k. We can, however, provide a W-9, an invoice referencing an agreed SOW, and standard net-30 payment terms.

Attached: OldTown_onboarding_form.pdf and OldTown_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf.

Is there a way to onboard us as a vendor and accept an invoice-only path for this pilot? If PO is strictly required, can we discuss a temporary exception process?

Paul Reed (cc) is handling billing on our side.

Appreciate any guidance —
Jessica Park
Head of Finance, OldTown Systems
jessica@oldtownsys.com
+1 415-555-0182

--
Attachment stubs: OldTown_onboarding_form.pdf (application form, 2 pages); OldTown_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (summary)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@oldtownsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding OldTown Systems — pilot invoicing & PO?

Thanks Jessica — and great to meet you (virtually).

Marissa and I reviewed the pilot scope. We can probably support an invoice-only path for a short pilot if procurement and finance can sign off on a controlled exception. Requesting Karthik and Naomi to weigh in with the approval steps we need.

Proposed approach:
- Create vendor record in our system conditional on receipt of W-9 and the completed onboarding form (attached).
- Allow a one-time \"invoice-only\" window for the pilot up to $12,000, payable net 30.
- Require a signed SOW (DocuSign link to follow) that references the invoice and includes deliverables & duration.
- If spend will exceed the pilot cap or the relationship moves to committed/production, require standard PO issuance from Redwood before additional work.

Marissa: can you confirm commercial terms and confirm whether OldTown needs any changes to the SOW?
Karthik / Naomi: can you advise whether the proposed $12k invoice-only cap and controls are acceptable, and what documentation you need to approve?

Jessica / Paul: once we have the W-9 and the signed SOW we can begin vendor setup.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Park <jessica@oldtownsys.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding OldTown Systems — pilot invoicing & PO?

Laura — quick read and initial approval in principle. A few procurement controls we need to put in place for an invoice-only exception to be granted: 

1) Completed vendor onboarding form and W-9 on file (OldTown_onboarding_form.pdf provided; W-9 still required).
2) Signed SOW that explicitly states this is a time-limited pilot and references the invoice terms.
3) Exception duration limited to 45 days from vendor setup; no recurring invoice-only renewals without PO.
4) Cap the pilot to $10,000 if we want to avoid additional approvers; if the business wants the $12k cap, we'll need a single approver from Finance and Procurement leadership (Naomi + me) to sign off.
5) Please add a short \"Legacy Billing Addendum\" clause to the SOW that states OldTown will transition to PO-based billing for any follow-on engagement.

Marissa: can you push the SOW draft to DocuSign and include the addendum? I'll create a procurement ticket and track the exception (PR-9876).

Also: please confirm vendor tax status (US corp / LLC) so finance can validate W-9 processing.

-Karthik
Head of Procurement Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Park <jessica@oldtownsys.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding OldTown Systems — pilot invoicing & PO?

Thanks — I can approve an invoice-only onboarding for this pilot with the following firm items in place: 

- W-9 submitted and validated
- Signed SOW (DocuSign) that includes the Legacy Billing Addendum
- Vendor onboarding form completed (we have the PDF but need the completed fields returned)
- Cap the pilot to $10,000 (per our small-dollar approval threshold). If business insists on $12,000 we need VP Finance approval and an explicit justification on file.

I attached the relevant excerpt from our payment policy for reference (payment_policy_excerpt.pdf). Once the above are received, I'll create the vendor code and authorize a one-time invoice-only workflow in our AP system, with a 45-day expiration. Please send the final SOW and W-9 to procurement@redwood.com and cc finance so I can expedite the vendor setup.

Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Accounts Payable
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
From: Jessica Park <jessica@oldtownsys.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding OldTown Systems — pilot invoicing & PO?

Perfect — thanks Naomi and Karthik for the quick review and clear checklist. We'll proceed with the $10,000 cap to keep approvals light.

Action items on our side this afternoon:
- Send completed onboarding form (attached) and W-9 to procurement@redwood.com (will do now).
- Review and sign SOW (DocuSign link awaited from Marissa).
- Confirm net-30 payment terms on invoice.

Can you confirm when the vendor code will be created once you have the documents? That would help us schedule the pilot start for Oct 19.

Thanks —
Jessica Park
Head of Finance, OldTown Systems
